name: Mold Under Hardwood Floors in Edmonds: Signs and Next Steps
title-tag: Mold Under Hardwood Floors: An Edmonds, WA Guide
meta-description: Musty smell, cupped boards, spreading stains — what they mean, what they don’t, and the order of operations before any Edmonds floor gets sanded.
post-summary: March 12, 2027 · A musty smell at floor level, cupped or spongy boards, and staining that spreads from a source are the real signs — inky black spots usually aren’t. The order that saves money: stop the water, dry and measure, remediate, then talk about the floor.
